const bases := "ACGT"
const allowed := "ACGTRYSWKMBDHVN-"
int[] base_sets()
    return [1, 2, 4, 8, 5, 10, 6, 9, 12, 3, 14, 13, 11, 7, 15, 15]

int character_index(string text, string wanted)
    for: i < int(#text)
        if text[i] == wanted
            return i
    return -1

int base_set(string character)
    index := character_index(allowed, character)
    return if index < 0 then 0 else base_sets()[index]

int base_index(string character)
    return character_index(bases, character)

string uppercase(string text)
    lower := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    upper := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
    result := ""
    for: i < int(#text)
        index := character_index(lower, text[i])
        result += if index < 0 then text[i] else upper[index]
    return result

class Record(int line, string name, string sequence)

Record[] read_fasta()
    string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/alignment.fasta"))
    lines := text.split(NL)
    Record[] records := []
    name := ""
    sequence := ""
    header_line := 0
    for: i < int(#lines) - 1
        line := lines[i]
        if line[0] == ">"
            if header_line > 0
                records = records.append(Record(header_line, name, uppercase(sequence)))
            name = line[1:<int(#line)].split(" ")[0]
            header_line = i + 1
            sequence = ""
        else
            sequence += line
    return records.append(Record(header_line, name, uppercase(sequence)))

class Patterns(string[] texts, int[][] encoded, int[] weights, int[] columns)

Patterns compress_patterns(string[] sequences)
    string[] texts := []
    int[] weights := []
    int[] columns := []
    for: c < int(#sequences[0])
        pattern := [for sequence := sequences[] then sequence[c]].join("")
        index := -1
        for: i < int(#texts)
            if texts[i] == pattern
                index = i
                break
        if index < 0
            index = int(#texts)
            texts = texts.append(pattern)
            weights = weights.append(0)
        weights[index] += 1
        columns = columns.append(index)
    encoded := [for pattern := texts[] then [for i := (0:<int(#pattern))[] then base_set(pattern[i])]]
    return Patterns(texts, encoded, weights, columns)

int[] classify_columns(string[] sequences)
    totals := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    for: c < int(#sequences[0])
        counts := [0, 0, 0, 0]
        gapped := false
        for sequence := sequences[]
            base := base_index(sequence[c])
            if base >= 0
                counts[base] += 1
            if sequence[c] == "-"
                gapped = true
        kinds := int(#[for count := counts[] if count > 0 then count])
        repeated := int(#[for count := counts[] if count >= 2 then count])
        if kinds == 0
            totals[4] += 1
        elif kinds == 1
            totals[0] += 1
        else
            totals[1] += 1
        if repeated >= 2
            totals[2] += 1
        if gapped
            totals[3] += 1
    return totals

import math
import alignment = "./alignment.qui"

int[] tally_pair(string first, string second, int[] weights)
    sites := 0
    transitions := 0
    transversions := 0
    for: c < int(#weights)
        a := alignment.base_index(first[c])
        b := alignment.base_index(second[c])
        if a < 0 or b < 0
            continue
        sites += weights[c]
        if a != b
            transition := (a == 0 and b == 2) or (a == 2 and b == 0) or (a == 1 and b == 3) or (a == 3 and b == 1)
            if transition
                transitions += weights[c]
            else
                transversions += weights[c]
    return [sites, transitions, transversions]

bool saturated(int[] counts, int model)
    n := counts[0]
    s := counts[1]
    v := counts[2]
    return n == 0 or (model == 1 and 4 * (s + v) >= 3 * n) or (model == 2 and (2 * s + v >= n or 2 * v >= n))

real64 corrected(int[] counts, int model, real64 saturation_distance)
    if saturated(counts, model)
        return saturation_distance
    n := real64(counts[0])
    s := counts[1]
    v := counts[2]
    if model == 0
        return real64(s + v) / n
    if model == 1
        logarithm := math.log(1.0 - real64(4 * (s + v)) / real64(3 * counts[0]))
        return -0.75 * logarithm
    first := math.log(1.0 - real64(2 * s) / n - real64(v) / n)
    second := math.log(1.0 - real64(2 * v) / n)
    return -0.5 * first - 0.25 * second

class Matrix(real64[][] values, int[][][] tallies, bool[][] saturated_pairs)

Matrix build_matrix(string[] sequences, int[] weights, int model, real64 saturation_distance)
    size := int(#sequences)
    real64[][] values := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then [for j := (0:<int(size))[] then 0.0]]
    int[][][] tallies := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then [for j := (0:<int(size))[] then [0, 0, 0]]]
    saturated_pairs := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then [for j := (0:<int(size))[] then false]]
    for: i < size
        for: i + 1 <= j < size
            counts := tally_pair(sequences[i], sequences[j], weights)
            value := corrected(counts, model, saturation_distance)
            tallies[i][j] = counts
            tallies[j][i] = counts
            values[i][j] = value
            values[j][i] = value
            saturated_pairs[i][j] = saturated(counts, model)
            saturated_pairs[j][i] = saturated_pairs[i][j]
    return Matrix(values, tallies, saturated_pairs)

import math
import alignment = "./alignment.qui"
import distances = "./distances.qui"
import tree_building = "./tree_building.qui"
import parsimony = "./parsimony.qui"
import tree_io = "./tree_io.qui"

string[] model_names()
    return ["P", "JC", "K2P"]

string[] methods()
    return ["NJ_P", "NJ_JC", "NJ_K2P", "ME", "MP", "CONSENSUS"]


int integer(string text)
    value := int(text)
    return value

real64 number(string text)
    value := real64(text)
    return value

string[] read_lines(string path)
    string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    lines := text.split(NL)
    return lines[0:<int(#lines) - 1]

int name_index(string[] values, string wanted)
    for: i < int(#values)
        if values[i] == wanted
            return i
    return -1

bool has_integer(int[] values, int wanted)
    for value := values[]
        if value == wanted
            return true
    return false

int sum_integers(int[] values)
    result := 0
    for value := values[]
        result += value
    return result

real64 sum_reals(real64[] values)
    real64 result := 0.0
    for value := values[]
        result += value
    return result

int population_count(int mask, int size)
    count := 0
    for: taxon < size
        if tree_io.contains_taxon(mask, taxon)
            count += 1
    return count

int mask_intersection(int first, int second, int size)
    result := 0
    for: taxon < size
        if tree_io.contains_taxon(first, taxon) and tree_io.contains_taxon(second, taxon)
            result += 2 ^ taxon
    return result

bool subset(int first, int second, int size)
    return mask_intersection(first, second, size) == first

int[] unique_integers(int[] values)
    int[] result := []
    for value := values.sorted()[]
        if #result == 0 or result[-1] != value
            result = result.append(value)
    return result

class Params(int model, string outgroup_name, int replicates, int seed, int max_missing, real64 saturation, string[] exhaustive_names, int low_sites)

Params read_parameters()
    rows := [for row := read_lines("input/params.txt")[] then row.split(" ")]
    return Params(name_index(model_names(), rows[0][1]), rows[1][1], integer(rows[2][1]), integer(rows[3][1]), integer(rows[4][1]), number(rows[5][1]), rows[6][1:<int(#rows[6])], integer(rows[7][1]))

class Rejection(int line, string name, string reason)
class Checked(string[] names, string[] sequences, Rejection[] rejected, int columns)

Checked check_records(alignment.Record[] records, int maximum_missing)
    length := int(#records[0].sequence)
    distinct<string> seen
    string[] names := []
    string[] sequences := []
    Rejection[] rejected := []
    for record := records[]
        reason := if seen.has(record.name) then "duplicate name" else ""
        .seen.add(record.name)
        if reason == ""
            for: c < int(#record.sequence)
                if alignment.base_set(record.sequence[c]) == 0
                    reason = "invalid character {record.sequence[c]} at column {c + 1}"
                    break
        if reason == "" and int(#record.sequence) != length
            reason = "length mismatch {#record.sequence}"
        if reason == ""
            missing := 0
            for: c < length
                if record.sequence[c] == "-" or record.sequence[c] == "N"
                    missing += 1
            if 100 * missing > maximum_missing * length
                reason = "too many missing {missing}"
        if reason == ""
            names = names.append(record.name)
            sequences = sequences.append(record.sequence)
        else
            rejected = rejected.append(Rejection(record.line, record.name, reason))
    return Checked(names, sequences, rejected, length)

class Bounds(int minimum, int maximum, int[] by_column)

Bounds parsimony_bounds(alignment.Patterns patterns)
    int[] minimum_by_pattern := []
    maximum := 0
    for: p < int(#patterns.encoded)
        pattern := patterns.encoded[p]
        minimum := 4
        for: 1 <= mask < 16
            intersects := true
            for bases := pattern[]
                intersects = intersects and parsimony.intersection(mask, bases) != 0
            if intersects
                count := population_count(mask, 4) - 1
                if count < minimum
                    minimum = count
        minimum_by_pattern = minimum_by_pattern.append(minimum)
        greatest := int(#pattern)
        for: base < 4
            count := int(#[for bases := pattern[] if not parsimony.contains_base(bases, base) then bases])
            if count < greatest
                greatest = count
        maximum += greatest * patterns.weights[p]
    by_column := [for column := patterns.columns[] then minimum_by_pattern[column]]
    return Bounds(sum_integers(by_column), maximum, by_column)

real64 bme_length(tree_building.Tree tree, real64[][] matrix)
    taxa := tree.taxa()
    real64 result := 0.0
    for: i < int(#taxa)
        first := taxa[i]
        steps := tree_building.path_steps(tree, first)
        for: i + 1 <= j < int(#taxa)
            second := taxa[j]
            result += matrix[first][second] / real64(2 ^ (steps[second] - 1))
    return result

class Stepwise(tree_building.Tree tree, int initial, int score, int[][] additions, int evaluated, int[] taxa)

Stepwise stepwise_addition(int[] taxa, int size, alignment.Patterns patterns, int outgroup)
    tree := tree_building.star(size, taxa[0:<3])
    initial := parsimony.score(tree, patterns.encoded, patterns.weights, outgroup)
    current := initial
    int[][] additions := []
    evaluated := 0
    for taxon := taxa[3:<int(#taxa)][]
        chosen := tree
        best := -1
        selected_mask := 0
        ties := 0
        for branch := parsimony.branches(tree, outgroup)[]
            candidate := parsimony.insert(tree, branch[1], branch[2], taxon)
            value := parsimony.score(candidate, patterns.encoded, patterns.weights, outgroup)
            evaluated += 1
            if best < 0 or value < best
                best = value
                chosen = candidate
                selected_mask = branch[0]
                ties = 1
            elif value == best
                ties += 1
        tree = chosen
        current = best
        additions = additions.append([taxon, selected_mask, current, ties])
    return Stepwise(tree, initial, current, additions, evaluated, taxa)

class ParsMove(int mask, int swap, int score)
class ParsSearch(tree_building.Tree tree, int score, ParsMove[] moves, int evaluated)

ParsSearch search_parsimony(tree_building.Tree initial, alignment.Patterns patterns, int outgroup)
    tree := initial
    current := parsimony.score(tree, patterns.encoded, patterns.weights, outgroup)
    ParsMove[] moves := []
    evaluated := 0
    while true
        improved := false
        for candidate := parsimony.nni_candidates(tree, outgroup)[]
            value := parsimony.score(candidate.tree, patterns.encoded, patterns.weights, outgroup)
            evaluated += 1
            if value < current
                tree = candidate.tree
                current = value
                moves = moves.append(ParsMove(candidate.mask, candidate.swap, value))
                improved = true
                break
        if not improved
            break
    return ParsSearch(tree, current, moves, evaluated)

class BmeMove(int mask, int swap, real64 length)
class BmeSearch(tree_building.Tree tree, real64 length, BmeMove[] moves, int evaluated)

BmeSearch search_bme(tree_building.Tree initial, real64[][] matrix, int outgroup)
    tree := initial
    current := bme_length(tree, matrix)
    BmeMove[] moves := []
    evaluated := 0
    while true
        improved := false
        for candidate := parsimony.nni_candidates(tree, outgroup)[]
            value := bme_length(candidate.tree, matrix)
            evaluated += 1
            if value < current
                tree = candidate.tree
                current = value
                moves = moves.append(BmeMove(candidate.mask, candidate.swap, value))
                improved = true
                break
        if not improved
            break
    return BmeSearch(tree, current, moves, evaluated)

void populate_consensus(tree_building.Tree &tree, int parent, int mask, int[] clades)
    size := tree.size
    int[] maximal := []
    for clade := clades[]
        if clade == mask or not subset(clade, mask, size)
            continue
        contained := false
        for other := clades[]
            if other != clade and other != mask and subset(clade, other, size) and subset(other, mask, size)
                contained = true
        if not contained
            maximal = maximal.append(clade)
    covered := 0
    for clade := maximal[]
        node := .tree.internal()
        .tree.connect(parent, node)
        populate_consensus(&tree, node, clade, clades)
        covered += clade
    for: taxon < size
        if tree_io.contains_taxon(mask, taxon) and not tree_io.contains_taxon(covered, taxon)
            .tree.connect(parent, taxon)

tree_building.Tree consensus_tree(int size, int[] taxa, int outgroup, int[] clades)
    tree := tree_building.empty_tree(size)
    root := .tree.internal()
    .tree.connect(root, outgroup)
    ingroup := sum_integers([for taxon := taxa[] if taxon != outgroup then 2 ^ taxon])
    populate_consensus(&tree, root, ingroup, clades)
    return tree

class Exhaustive(tree_building.Tree[] trees, int[] scores, real64[] lengths, string[] newicks, int best, int[] optimal, tree_building.Tree strict, int heuristic_score, int bme_best, real64 second)

Exhaustive exhaustive_search(int size, int[] taxa, int outgroup, alignment.Patterns patterns, real64[][] matrix, string[] names)
    trees := [tree_building.star(size, taxa[0:<3])]
    for taxon := taxa[3:<int(#taxa)][]
        tree_building.Tree[] expanded := []
        for tree := trees[]
            for branch := parsimony.branches(tree, outgroup)[]
                expanded = expanded.append(parsimony.insert(tree, branch[1], branch[2], taxon))
        trees = expanded
    scores := [for tree := trees[] then parsimony.score(tree, patterns.encoded, patterns.weights, outgroup)]
    lengths := [for tree := trees[] then bme_length(tree, matrix)]
    newicks := [for tree := trees[] then tree_io.newick(tree, names, outgroup, false, [], false)]
    best := scores.sorted()[0]
    optimal_text := [for i := (0:<int(#trees))[] if scores[i] == best then newicks[i]].sorted()
    optimal := [for text := optimal_text[] then name_index(newicks, text)]
    common := tree_building.split_set(trees[optimal[0]], outgroup)
    for index := optimal[1:<int(#optimal)][]
        splits := tree_building.split_set(trees[index], outgroup)
        common = [for mask := common[] if has_integer(splits, mask) then mask]
    strict := consensus_tree(size, taxa, outgroup, common)
    heuristic_start := stepwise_addition(taxa, size, patterns, outgroup)
    heuristic_score := search_parsimony(heuristic_start.tree, patterns, outgroup).score
    bme_best := 0
    for: i < int(#trees)
        earlier := [newicks[i], newicks[bme_best]].sorted()[0] == newicks[i]
        if lengths[i] < lengths[bme_best] or (lengths[i] == lengths[bme_best] and earlier)
            bme_best = i
    second := [for i := (0:<int(#trees))[] if i != bme_best then lengths[i]].sorted()[0]
    return Exhaustive(trees, scores, lengths, newicks, best, optimal, strict, heuristic_score, bme_best, second)

real64[] site_likelihoods(tree_building.Tree tree, alignment.Patterns patterns, int outgroup, string[] names)
    orientation := tree_building.root_tree(tree, outgroup)
    children := tree_io.child_order(tree, orientation, names)
    nodes := int(#tree.adjacent)
    real64[] same := [for node := (0:<int(nodes))[] then 0.0]
    different := same
    for node := orientation.order[1:<int(#orientation.order)][]
        decay := math.exp(-(4.0 * tree.lengths[node][orientation.parents[node]]) / 3.0)
        same[node] = 0.25 + 0.75 * decay
        different[node] = 0.25 - 0.25 * decay
    real64[] by_pattern := []
    for pattern := patterns.encoded[]
        real64[][] values := [for node := (0:<int(nodes))[] then [for x := (0:<4)[] then 0.0]]
        for node := orientation.order[::-1][]
            if node < tree.size
                values[node] = [for x := (0:<4)[] then (if parsimony.contains_base(pattern[node], x) then 1.0 else 0.0)]
            else
                for: x < 4
                    real64 product := 1.0
                    for child := children[node][]
                        real64 sum := 0.0
                        for: y < 4
                            sum += (if x == y then same[child] else different[child]) * values[child][y]
                        product *= sum
                    values[node][x] = product
        joint := sum_reals([for x := (0:<4)[] then 0.25 * values[orientation.root][x]])
        logarithm := math.log(joint)
        by_pattern = by_pattern.append(logarithm)
    return [for column := patterns.columns[] then by_pattern[column]]

int rf_distance(int[] first, int[] second)
    result := 0
    for mask := first[]
        if not has_integer(second, mask)
            result += 1
    for mask := second[]
        if not has_integer(first, mask)
            result += 1
    return result

int quartet_topology(int[] splits, int a, int b, int c, int d)
    for mask := splits[]
        aa := tree_io.contains_taxon(mask, a)
        bb := tree_io.contains_taxon(mask, b)
        cc := tree_io.contains_taxon(mask, c)
        dd := tree_io.contains_taxon(mask, d)
        if aa == bb and cc == dd and aa != cc
            return 1
        if aa == cc and bb == dd and aa != bb
            return 2
        if aa == dd and bb == cc and aa != bb
            return 3
    return 0

int quartet_distance(int[] first, int[] second, int size)
    result := 0
    for: a < size
        for: a + 1 <= b < size
            for: b + 1 <= c < size
                for: c + 1 <= d < size
                    if quartet_topology(first, a, b, c, d) != quartet_topology(second, a, b, c, d)
                        result += 1
    return result

class Generator(int state)
    int .draw()
        state = (48271 * state) % 2147483647
        return state

class Bootstrap(int[] supports, string[] replicate_lines, int identical, tree_building.Tree consensus, int[] appeared)

Bootstrap bootstrap_trees(string[] sequences, int[] taxa, int outgroup, Params params, int[] main_splits)
    size := int(#taxa)
    length := int(#sequences[0])
    generator := Generator(params.seed)
    supports := [for mask := (0:<int(2 ^ size))[] then 0]
    string[] lines := []
    identical := 0
    for: 1 <= replicate <= params.replicates
        weights := [for c := (0:<int(length))[] then 0]
        for: draw < length
            value := .generator.draw()
            weights[value % length] += 1
        matrix := distances.build_matrix(sequences, weights, params.model, params.saturation).values
        tree := tree_building.neighbor_joining(matrix, taxa)
        splits := tree_building.split_set(tree, outgroup)
        for mask := splits[]
            supports[mask] += 1
        rf := rf_distance(splits, main_splits)
        if rf == 0
            identical += 1
        distinct_count := int(#[for weight := weights[] if weight > 0 then weight])
        lines = lines.append("REPLICATE {replicate} distinct {distinct_count} rf {rf}")
    appeared := [for mask := (0:<int(#supports))[] if supports[mask] > 0 then mask]
    majority := [for mask := appeared[] if 2 * supports[mask] > params.replicates then mask]
    return Bootstrap(supports, lines, identical, consensus_tree(size, taxa, outgroup, majority), appeared)

string state_character(int state)
    for: base < 4
        if state == 2 ^ base
            return alignment.bases[base]
    return "N"

string[] format_matrix(string[] names, real64[][] matrix)
    width := 0
    for name := names[]
        if int(#name) > width
            width = int(#name)
    string[] lines := []
    for: i < int(#names)
        string padding := " " * nat(width - int(#names[i]))
        values := [for value := matrix[i][] then tree_io.format_real(value, 5)].join(" ")
        lines = lines.append(names[i] + padding + " " + values)
    return lines

class Study(alignment.Record[] records, Params params)
    Checked checked := check_records(records, params.max_missing)
    string[] names := checked.names
    string[] sequences := checked.sequences
    size := int(#names)
    int length := checked.columns
    int outgroup := name_index(names, params.outgroup_name)
    int[] taxa := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then i]
    int[] ingroup := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] if i != outgroup then i]
    int[] exhaustive_taxa := [outgroup].concat([for i := ingroup[] if has_integer([for name := params.exhaustive_names[] then name_index(names, name)], i) then i])
    alignment.Patterns patterns := alignment.compress_patterns(sequences)
    int[] ordinary_weights := [for c := (0:<int(length))[] then 1]
    distances.Matrix[] matrices := [for model := (0:<3)[] then distances.build_matrix(sequences, ordinary_weights, model, params.saturation)]
    real64[][] main_matrix := matrices[params.model].values
    tree_building.Tree[] nj_trees := [for matrix := matrices[] then tree_building.neighbor_joining(matrix.values, taxa)]
    tree_building.Tree main_tree := nj_trees[params.model]
    int[] main_splits := tree_building.split_set(main_tree, outgroup)
    bounds := parsimony_bounds(patterns)
    int[] mp_order := [outgroup].concat(ingroup)
    mp_start := stepwise_addition(mp_order, size, patterns, outgroup)
    ParsSearch mp_search := search_parsimony(mp_start.tree, patterns, outgroup)
    tree_building.Tree mp_tree := mp_search.tree
    parsimony.Reconstruction reconstruction := parsimony.reconstruct(mp_tree, patterns.encoded, patterns.weights, patterns.columns, outgroup)
    for: i < int(#reconstruction.branch_rows)
        .mp_tree.connect(reconstruction.branch_rows[i][1], reconstruction.branch_rows[i][2], real64(reconstruction.branch_changes[i]) / real64(length))
    me_search := search_bme(main_tree, main_matrix, outgroup)
    exhaustive := exhaustive_search(size, exhaustive_taxa, outgroup, patterns, main_matrix, names)
    real64[][] site_logs := [for tree := nj_trees[] then site_likelihoods(tree, patterns, outgroup, names)]
    real64[] loglik := [for values := site_logs[] then sum_reals(values)]
    int[][] nj_changes := []
    for tree := nj_trees[]
        local by_pattern := parsimony.pattern_scores(tree, patterns.encoded, outgroup)
        nj_changes = nj_changes.append([for column := patterns.columns[] then by_pattern[column]])
    bootstrap := bootstrap_trees(sequences, taxa, outgroup, params, main_splits)
    tree_building.Tree[] trees := nj_trees.concat([me_search.tree, mp_tree, bootstrap.consensus])
    int[][] splits := [for tree := trees[] then tree_building.split_set(tree, outgroup)]
    int[] scores := [for i := (0:<5)[] then parsimony.score(trees[i], patterns.encoded, patterns.weights, outgroup)]
    real64[] bme := [for i := (0:<5)[] then bme_length(trees[i], main_matrix)]
    real64[][][] patristic := [for tree := nj_trees[] then tree_building.patristic_matrix(tree)]
    real64[] tree_lengths := [for tree := nj_trees[] then sum_reals([for edge := tree.edges()[] then tree.lengths[edge[0]][edge[1]]])]
    real64[] squared_errors := [for model := (0:<3)[] then 0.0]
    for: model < 3
        for: i < size
            for: i + 1 <= j < size
                local difference := matrices[model].values[i][j] - patristic[model][i][j]
                squared_errors[model] += difference * difference

    string newick_text(tree_building.Tree tree, bool lengths, bool support)
        return tree_io.newick(tree, names, outgroup, lengths, bootstrap.supports, support)

    string[] summary_lines()
        lines := ["INPUT records {#records} accepted {size} rejected {#checked.rejected} columns {length}"]
        for rejection := checked.rejected[]
            lines = lines.append("REJECT line {rejection.line} {rejection.name} {rejection.reason}")
        column_counts := [for c := (0:<int(length))[] then [0, 0, 0, 0]]
        for sequence := sequences[]
            for: c < length
                base := alignment.base_index(sequence[c])
                if base >= 0
                    column_counts[c][base] += 1
        composition := [0, 0, 0, 0]
        for: taxon < size
            counts := [0, 0, 0, 0]
            ambiguous := 0
            missing := 0
            unique := 0
            for: c < length
                character := sequences[taxon][c]
                base := alignment.base_index(character)
                if base >= 0
                    counts[base] += 1
                    if column_counts[c][base] == 1 and sum_integers(column_counts[c]) > 1
                        unique += 1
                elif character == "-" or character == "N"
                    missing += 1
                else
                    ambiguous += 1
            bases := sum_integers(counts)
            gc := real64(counts[1] + counts[2]) / real64(bases)
            lines = lines.append("TAXON {names[taxon]} bases {bases} ambiguous {ambiguous} missing {missing} unique {unique} gc " + tree_io.format_real(gc, 4))
            for: base < 4
                composition[base] += counts[base]
        classes := alignment.classify_columns(sequences)
        lines = lines.concat(["COLUMNS constant {classes[0]} variable {classes[1]} informative {classes[2]} gapped {classes[3]} empty {classes[4]}", "PATTERNS {#patterns.texts}"])
        total := sum_integers(composition)
        string values := [for base := (0:<4)[] then alignment.bases[base] + " " + tree_io.format_real(real64(composition[base]) / real64(total), 4)].join(" ")
        return lines.append("COMPOSITION " + values)

    string[] distance_lines()
        methods_table := methods()
        string[][] blocks := []
        string[] pairs := []
        totals := [0, 0, 0]
        for: i < size
            for: i + 1 <= j < size
                counts := matrices[0].tallies[i][j]
                for: k < 3
                    totals[k] += counts[k]
                pairs = pairs.append("PAIR {names[i]} {names[j]} sites {counts[0]} transitions {counts[1]} transversions {counts[2]}")
        blocks = blocks.append(pairs.append("TOTAL sites {totals[0]} transitions {totals[1]} transversions {totals[2]}"))
        for: model < 3
            string[] lines := ["MODEL {model_names()[model]}"].concat(format_matrix(names, matrices[model].values))
            for: i < size
                for: i + 1 <= j < size
                    if matrices[model].saturated_pairs[i][j]
                        lines = lines.append("SATURATED {names[i]} {names[j]} sites {matrices[model].tallies[i][j][0]}")
            blocks = blocks.append(lines)
        blocks = blocks.append(["PATRISTIC {methods_table[params.model]}"].concat(format_matrix(names, patristic[params.model])))
        me := ["ME start {methods_table[params.model]} length " + tree_io.format_real(bme_length(main_tree, main_matrix), 5)]
        for move := me_search.moves[]
            me = me.append("NNI edge " + tree_io.symbols(move.mask, size) + " swap {move.swap} length " + tree_io.format_real(move.length, 5))
        me = me.concat(["ME moves {#me_search.moves} evaluated {me_search.evaluated} length " + tree_io.format_real(me_search.length, 5),
            "EXHAUSTIVE taxa {#exhaustive_taxa} trees {#exhaustive.trees} best " + tree_io.format_real(exhaustive.lengths[exhaustive.bme_best], 5) + " second " + tree_io.format_real(exhaustive.second, 5),
            "BEST {exhaustive.newicks[exhaustive.bme_best]} parsimony {exhaustive.scores[exhaustive.bme_best]}"])
        blocks = blocks.append(me)
        string[] result := []
        for block := blocks[]
            if #result != 0
                result = result.append("")
            result = result.concat(block)
        return result

    string[] tree_lines()
        return [for i := (0:<6)[] then methods()[i] + " " + newick_text(trees[i], i < 3 or i == 4, i == 5)]

    string[] cladogram_lines()
        string[] lines := []
        for: i < 6
            if i != 0
                lines = lines.append("")
            lines = lines.append("TREE {methods()[i]}").concat(tree_io.cladogram(trees[i], names, outgroup, bootstrap.supports))
        return lines

    string score_line(string method, int score)
        ci := real64(bounds.minimum) / real64(score)
        ri := real64(bounds.maximum - score) / real64(bounds.maximum - bounds.minimum)
        return "TREE {method} score {score} ci " + tree_io.format_real(ci, 4) + " ri " + tree_io.format_real(ri, 4)

    string[] parsimony_lines()
        lines := ["BOUNDS minimum {bounds.minimum} maximum {bounds.maximum}"]
        for: i < 3
            lines = lines.append(score_line(methods()[i], scores[i]))
        lines = lines.append("START {names[mp_order[0]]} {names[mp_order[1]]} {names[mp_order[2]]} score {mp_start.initial}")
        for addition := mp_start.additions[]
            lines = lines.append("ADD {names[addition[0]]} edge " + tree_io.symbols(addition[1], size) + " score {addition[2]} ties {addition[3]}")
        lines = lines.append("STEPWISE score {mp_start.score} evaluated {mp_start.evaluated}")
        for move := mp_search.moves[]
            lines = lines.append("NNI edge " + tree_io.symbols(move.mask, size) + " swap {move.swap} score {move.score}")
        lines = lines.concat(["SEARCH moves {#mp_search.moves} evaluated {mp_search.evaluated} score {mp_search.score}", score_line("MP", mp_search.score), "MP " + newick_text(mp_tree, true, false)])
        maximum := reconstruction.site_changes.sorted()[length - 1]
        for: changes <= maximum
            count := int(#[for value := reconstruction.site_changes[] if value == changes then value])
            lines = lines.append("CHANGES {changes} columns {count}")
        homoplasy := int(#[for c := (0:<int(length))[] if reconstruction.site_changes[c] > bounds.by_column[c] then c])
        lines = lines.append("HOMOPLASY columns {homoplasy} extra {mp_search.score - bounds.minimum}")
        orientation := tree_building.root_tree(mp_tree, outgroup)
        node_count := int(#mp_tree.adjacent)
        int[] keys := []
        for node := mp_tree.internal_nodes()[]
            mask := if node == orientation.root then orientation.ingroup else orientation.masks[node]
            keys = keys.append(tree_io.symbol_key(mask, size) * node_count + node)
        for key := keys.sorted()[]
            node := key % node_count
            mask := if node == orientation.root then orientation.ingroup else orientation.masks[node]
            sequence := [for state := reconstruction.states[node][] then state_character(state)].join("")
            lines = lines.append("ANCESTOR " + tree_io.symbols(mask, size) + " " + sequence)
        lines = lines.concat(["", "EXHAUSTIVE taxa {#exhaustive_taxa} trees {#exhaustive.trees} best {exhaustive.best} optimal {#exhaustive.optimal}"])
        for score := unique_integers(exhaustive.scores)[]
            count := int(#[for value := exhaustive.scores[] if value == score then value])
            lines = lines.append("SCORE {score} trees {count}")
        for index := exhaustive.optimal[]
            lines = lines.append("OPTIMAL {exhaustive.newicks[index]} bme " + tree_io.format_real(exhaustive.lengths[index], 5))
        lines = lines.append("STRICT " + newick_text(exhaustive.strict, false, false))
        return lines.append("HEURISTIC score {exhaustive.heuristic_score} optimal " + (if exhaustive.heuristic_score == exhaustive.best then "yes" else "no"))

    string[] likelihood_lines()
        methods_table := methods()
        lines := ["LIKELIHOOD columns {length} patterns {#patterns.texts}"]
        for: i < 3
            lines = lines.append("TREE {methods_table[i]} loglik " + tree_io.format_real(loglik[i], 4) + " per_site " + tree_io.format_real(loglik[i] / real64(length), 4))
        for: a < 3
            for: a + 1 <= b < 3
                deltas := [for c := (0:<int(length))[] then site_logs[a][c] - site_logs[b][c]]
                difference := sum_reals(deltas)
                average := difference / real64(length)
                variance_sum := sum_reals([for delta := deltas[] then (delta - average) * (delta - average)])
                se := math.sqrt((real64(length) / real64(length - 1)) * variance_sum)
                lines = lines.append("KH {methods_table[a]} {methods_table[b]} difference " + tree_io.format_real(difference, 4) + " se " + tree_io.format_real(se, 4) + " z " + tree_io.format_real(difference / se, 4))
        lines = lines.append("LOWEST {methods_table[params.model]} sites {params.low_sites}")
        units := [for value := site_logs[params.model][] then tree_io.rounded_units(value, 4)]
        minimum := units.sorted()[0]
        keys := [for c := (0:<int(length))[] then (units[c] - minimum) * length + c]
        ordered := keys.sorted()
        for: i < params.low_sites
            c := ordered[i] % length
            pattern := patterns.texts[patterns.columns[c]]
            lines = lines.append("SITE {c + 1} loglik " + tree_io.format_real(site_logs[params.model][c], 4) + " changes {nj_changes[params.model][c]} pattern {pattern}")
        return lines

    string[] bootstrap_lines()
        string[] lines := ["BOOTSTRAP model {model_names()[params.model]} replicates {params.replicates} seed {params.seed}"].concat(bootstrap.replicate_lines).append("IDENTICAL {bootstrap.identical}")
        for mask := tree_io.ordered_masks(main_splits, size)[]
            lines = lines.append("SUPPORT " + tree_io.symbols(mask, size) + " {bootstrap.supports[mask]}")
        base := 2 ^ size
        keys := [for mask := bootstrap.appeared[] then ((params.replicates - bootstrap.supports[mask]) * base + tree_io.symbol_key(mask, size)) * base + mask]
        for key := keys.sorted()[]
            mask := key % base
            lines = lines.append("SPLIT " + tree_io.symbols(mask, size) + " {bootstrap.supports[mask]}")
        lines = lines.append("CONSENSUS " + newick_text(bootstrap.consensus, false, true))
        for removed := ingroup[]
            remaining := [for taxon := taxa[] if taxon != removed then taxon]
            jackknife := tree_building.neighbor_joining(main_matrix, remaining)
            int[] restricted := []
            for mask := main_splits[]
                value := if tree_io.contains_taxon(mask, removed) then mask - 2 ^ removed else mask
                count := population_count(value, size)
                if count >= 2 and count <= size - 3
                    restricted = restricted.append(value)
            rf := rf_distance(tree_building.split_set(jackknife, outgroup), unique_integers(restricted))
            lines = lines.append("JACKKNIFE {names[removed]} rf {rf}")
        return lines

    string[] clock_lines()
        string[] pairs := []
        rejected := 0
        for: i < int(#ingroup)
            for: i + 1 <= j < int(#ingroup)
                a := ingroup[i]
                b := ingroup[j]
                m1 := 0
                m2 := 0
                for: c < length
                    first := alignment.base_index(sequences[a][c])
                    second := alignment.base_index(sequences[b][c])
                    reference := alignment.base_index(sequences[outgroup][c])
                    if first < 0 or second < 0 or reference < 0 or first == second
                        continue
                    if second == reference
                        m1 += 1
                    if first == reference
                        m2 += 1
                difference := m1 - m2
                numerator := difference * difference
                denominator := m1 + m2
                reject := 1000 * numerator > 3841 * denominator
                if reject
                    rejected += 1
                chi2 := if denominator == 0 then "-" else tree_io.format_real(real64(numerator) / real64(denominator), 4)
                pairs = pairs.append("RRT {names[a]} {names[b]} m1 {m1} m2 {m2} chi2 {chi2} " + (if reject then "reject" else "ok"))
        string[] lines := ["RELATIVE_RATE outgroup {names[outgroup]} pairs {#pairs} rejected {rejected}"].concat(pairs)
        orientation := tree_building.root_tree(main_tree, outgroup)
        values := tree_building.path_distances(main_tree, orientation.root)
        average := sum_reals([for taxon := ingroup[] then values[taxon]]) / real64(#ingroup)
        variance := sum_reals([for taxon := ingroup[] then (values[taxon] - average) * (values[taxon] - average)]) / real64(int(#ingroup) - 1)
        sd := math.sqrt(variance)
        lines = lines.append("ROOT_TO_TIP {methods()[params.model]} mean " + tree_io.format_real(average, 5) + " sd " + tree_io.format_real(sd, 5) + " cv " + tree_io.format_real(sd / average, 4))
        for taxon := ingroup[]
            lines = lines.append("TIP {names[taxon]} " + tree_io.format_real(values[taxon], 5))
        return lines

    string[] comparison_lines()
        methods_table := methods()
        string[] lines := []
        for: i < 6
            supported := int(#[for mask := splits[i][] if 2 * bootstrap.supports[mask] > params.replicates then mask])
            score := if i == 5 then "-" else string(scores[i])
            evolution := if i == 5 then "-" else tree_io.format_real(bme[i], 5)
            total_length := if i < 3 then tree_io.format_real(tree_lengths[i], 5) elif i == 4 then tree_io.format_real(real64(mp_search.score) / real64(length), 5) else "-"
            negative := if i < 3 then string(nj_trees[i].negative) else "-"
            sse := if i < 3 then tree_io.format_real(squared_errors[i], 6) else "-"
            likelihood := if i < 3 then tree_io.format_real(loglik[i], 4) else "-"
            lines = lines.append("TREE {methods_table[i]} splits {#splits[i]} supported {supported} parsimony {score} bme {evolution} length {total_length} negative {negative} sse {sse} loglik {likelihood}")
        lines = lines.append("RF " + methods_table.join(" "))
        for: a < 6
            values := [for b := (0:<6)[] then string(rf_distance(splits[a], splits[b]))].join(" ")
            lines = lines.append(methods_table[a] + " " + values)
        lines = lines.append("QUARTET " + methods_table.join(" "))
        for: a < 6
            values := [for b := (0:<6)[] then string(quartet_distance(splits[a], splits[b], size))].join(" ")
            lines = lines.append(methods_table[a] + " " + values)
        int[] all_clades := []
        for clades := splits[]
            all_clades = all_clades.concat(clades)
        all_clades = tree_io.ordered_masks(unique_integers(all_clades), size)
        main_branches := parsimony.branches(main_tree, outgroup)
        for mask := all_clades[]
            marks := [for i := (0:<6)[] then (if has_integer(splits[i], mask) then "+" else "-")].join("")
            branch_length := "-"
            for branch := main_branches[]
                if branch[0] == mask
                    branch_length = tree_io.format_real(main_tree.lengths[branch[1]][branch[2]], 5)
                    break
            changes := "-"
            for: i < int(#reconstruction.branch_rows)
                if reconstruction.branch_rows[i][0] == mask
                    changes = string(reconstruction.branch_changes[i])
                    break
            lines = lines.append("CLADE " + tree_io.symbols(mask, size) + " support {bootstrap.supports[mask]} trees {marks} length {branch_length} changes {changes}")
        return lines

    string[] hypothesis_lines()
        string[] lines := []
        ingroup_mask := sum_integers([for taxon := ingroup[] then 2 ^ taxon])
        exhaustive_ingroup := sum_integers([for taxon := exhaustive_taxa[] if taxon != outgroup then 2 ^ taxon])
        exhaustive_splits := [for tree := exhaustive.trees[] then tree_building.split_set(tree, outgroup)]
        for row := read_lines("input/clades.txt")[]
            fields := row.split(" ")
            name := fields[0]
            mask := 0
            reason := ""
            for taxon_name := fields[1:<int(#fields)][]
                taxon := name_index(names, taxon_name)
                if taxon < 0
                    reason = "unknown taxon {taxon_name}"
                    break
                mask += 2 ^ taxon
            if reason == "" and tree_io.contains_taxon(mask, outgroup)
                reason = "contains outgroup"
            if reason != ""
                lines = lines.append("INVALID {name} {reason}")
                continue
            lines = lines.append("CLADE {name} taxa {population_count(mask, size)} support {bootstrap.supports[mask]}")
            for: i < 6
                common := ingroup_mask
                for clade := splits[i][]
                    if subset(mask, clade, size) and population_count(clade, size) < population_count(common, size)
                        common = clade
                intruders := [for taxon := ingroup[] if tree_io.contains_taxon(common, taxon) and not tree_io.contains_taxon(mask, taxon) then names[taxon]]
                joined := if #intruders == 0 then "-" else intruders.join(",")
                monophyletic := if common == mask then "yes" else "no"
                lines = lines.append("TEST {name} {methods()[i]} monophyletic {monophyletic} mrca {population_count(common, size)} intruders {joined}")
            restricted := mask_intersection(mask, exhaustive_ingroup, size)
            count := population_count(restricted, size)
            if count < 2 or count >= int(#exhaustive_taxa) - 1
                lines = lines.append("SUBSET {name} untestable")
            else
                score_min := [0, 0]
                real64[] bme_min := [0.0, 0.0]
                seen := [false, false]
                for: index < int(#exhaustive.trees)
                    side := if has_integer(exhaustive_splits[index], restricted) then 0 else 1
                    if not seen[side] or exhaustive.scores[index] < score_min[side]
                        score_min[side] = exhaustive.scores[index]
                    if not seen[side] or exhaustive.lengths[index] < bme_min[side]
                        bme_min[side] = exhaustive.lengths[index]
                    seen[side] = true
                lines = lines.append("SUBSET {name} taxa {count} with {score_min[0]} without {score_min[1]} bme_with " + tree_io.format_real(bme_min[0], 5) + " bme_without " + tree_io.format_real(bme_min[1], 5))
        return lines

void run_program()
    study := Study(alignment.read_fasta(), read_parameters())
    tree_io.write_lines("summary.txt", study.summary_lines())
    tree_io.write_lines("distances.txt", study.distance_lines())
    tree_io.write_lines("trees.nwk", study.tree_lines())
    tree_io.write_lines("cladograms.txt", study.cladogram_lines())
    tree_io.write_lines("parsimony.txt", study.parsimony_lines())
    tree_io.write_lines("likelihood.txt", study.likelihood_lines())
    tree_io.write_lines("bootstrap.txt", study.bootstrap_lines())
    tree_io.write_lines("clock.txt", study.clock_lines())
    tree_io.write_lines("comparison.txt", study.comparison_lines())
    tree_io.write_lines("hypotheses.txt", study.hypothesis_lines())

run_program()

import tree_building = "./tree_building.qui"

bool contains_base(int mask, int base)
    return (mask / (2 ^ base)) % 2 == 1

int intersection(int first, int second)
    result := 0
    for: base < 4
        if contains_base(first, base) and contains_base(second, base)
            result += 2 ^ base
    return result

int[] merge(int first, int second)
    common := intersection(first, second)
    return if common != 0 then [common, 0] else [first + second, 1]

int first_base(int mask)
    for: base < 4
        if contains_base(mask, base)
            return 2 ^ base
    return 0

class Provisional(int[] sets, int changes)

Provisional provisional(tree_building.Tree tree, tree_building.Rooted orientation, int[] pattern, int outgroup)
    sets := [for node := (0:<int(#tree.adjacent))[] then 0]
    changes := 0
    for node := orientation.order[::-1][]
        if node < tree.size
            sets[node] = pattern[node]
        else
            children := [for child := orientation.children[node][] if child != outgroup then child]
            combined := merge(sets[children[0]], sets[children[1]])
            sets[node] = combined[0]
            changes += combined[1]
            if node == orientation.root
                changes += merge(sets[node], sets[outgroup])[1]
    return Provisional(sets, changes)

int[] pattern_scores(tree_building.Tree tree, int[][] patterns, int outgroup)
    orientation := tree_building.root_tree(tree, outgroup)
    return [for pattern := patterns[] then provisional(tree, orientation, pattern, outgroup).changes]

int score(tree_building.Tree tree, int[][] patterns, int[] weights, int outgroup)
    changes := pattern_scores(tree, patterns, outgroup)
    result := 0
    for: i < int(#changes)
        result += changes[i] * weights[i]
    return result

int[][] branches(tree_building.Tree tree, int outgroup)
    orientation := tree_building.root_tree(tree, outgroup)
    int[][] rows := []
    for child := orientation.order[1:<int(#orientation.order)][]
        mask := if child == outgroup then orientation.ingroup else orientation.masks[child]
        rows = rows.append([mask, orientation.parents[child], child])
    size := int(#rows)
    keys := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then rows[i][0] * size + i]
    return [for key := keys.sorted()[] then rows[key % size]]

class Reconstruction(int[][] states, int[][] branch_rows, int[] branch_changes, int[] site_changes)

Reconstruction reconstruct(tree_building.Tree tree, int[][] patterns, int[] weights, int[] columns, int outgroup)
    orientation := tree_building.root_tree(tree, outgroup)
    rows := branches(tree, outgroup)
    branch_changes := [for i := (0:<int(#rows))[] then 0]
    int[][] states_by_pattern := []
    int[] changes_by_pattern := []
    for: index < int(#patterns)
        result := provisional(tree, orientation, patterns[index], outgroup)
        sets := result.sets
        changes_by_pattern = changes_by_pattern.append(result.changes)
        initial := first_base(merge(sets[orientation.root], sets[outgroup])[0])
        states := [for node := (0:<int(#tree.adjacent))[] then 0]
        for node := [orientation.root, outgroup][]
            states[node] = if intersection(sets[node], initial) != 0 then initial else first_base(sets[node])
        for node := orientation.order[1:<int(#orientation.order)][]
            if node != outgroup
                parent_state := states[orientation.parents[node]]
                states[node] = if intersection(sets[node], parent_state) != 0 then parent_state else first_base(sets[node])
        for: i < int(#rows)
            if states[rows[i][1]] != states[rows[i][2]]
                branch_changes[i] += weights[index]
        states_by_pattern = states_by_pattern.append(states)
    sequences := [for node := (0:<int(#tree.adjacent))[] then [for column := columns[] then states_by_pattern[column][node]]]
    return Reconstruction(sequences, rows, branch_changes, [for column := columns[] then changes_by_pattern[column]])

tree_building.Tree insert(tree_building.Tree tree, int first, int second, int taxon)
    result := tree
    .result.disconnect(first, second)
    node := .result.internal()
    .result.connect(first, node)
    .result.connect(second, node)
    .result.connect(taxon, node)
    return result

class Candidate(int mask, int swap, tree_building.Tree tree)

Candidate[] nni_candidates(tree_building.Tree tree, int outgroup)
    orientation := tree_building.root_tree(tree, outgroup)
    Candidate[] candidates := []
    for edge := branches(tree, outgroup)[]
        first := edge[1]
        second := edge[2]
        if first < tree.size or second < tree.size
            continue
        sibling := -1
        for child := orientation.children[first][]
            if child != second and child != outgroup
                sibling = child
                break
        children := orientation.children[second]
        if orientation.masks[children[0]] > orientation.masks[children[1]]
            children = [children[1], children[0]]
        for: swap < 2
            child := children[swap]
            result := tree
            sibling_length := .result.disconnect(first, sibling)
            child_length := .result.disconnect(second, child)
            .result.connect(first, child, child_length)
            .result.connect(second, sibling, sibling_length)
            candidates = candidates.append(Candidate(edge[0], swap + 1, result))
    return candidates

bool contains_node(int[] values, int wanted)
    for value := values[]
        if value == wanted
            return true
    return false

class Tree(int size, int[][] adjacent, real64[][] lengths, int negative)
    int .internal()
        node := int(#adjacent)
        adjacent = adjacent.append([])
        for: i < node
            lengths[i] = lengths[i].append(0.0)
        lengths = lengths.append([for i := (0:<(int(node) + 1))[] then 0.0])
        return node

    void .connect(int first, int second, real64 length := 0.0)
        if not contains_node(adjacent[first], second)
            adjacent[first] = adjacent[first].append(second)
            adjacent[second] = adjacent[second].append(first)
        lengths[first][second] = length
        lengths[second][first] = length

    real64 .disconnect(int first, int second)
        length := lengths[first][second]
        adjacent[first] = [for value := adjacent[first][] if value != second then value]
        adjacent[second] = [for value := adjacent[second][] if value != first then value]
        lengths[first][second] = 0.0
        lengths[second][first] = 0.0
        return length

    int[] taxa()
        return [for i := (0:<int(size))[] if #adjacent[i] != 0 then i]

    int[] internal_nodes()
        return [for i := (int(size):<int(#adjacent))[] if #adjacent[i] != 0 then i]

    int[][] edges()
        int[][] result := []
        for: first < int(#adjacent)
            for second := adjacent[first].sorted()[]
                if first < second
                    result = result.append([first, second])
        return result

Tree empty_tree(int size)
    return Tree(size, [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then []], [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then [for j := (0:<int(size))[] then 0.0]], 0)

Tree star(int size, int[] taxa)
    result := empty_tree(size)
    node := .result.internal()
    for taxon := taxa[]
        .result.connect(node, taxon)
    return result

class Rooted(int root, int[] parents, int[][] children, int[] masks, int[] order, int ingroup)

void visit_nodes(Tree tree, int node, int parent, int[] &parents, int[][] &children, int[] &masks, int[] &order)
    parents[node] = parent
    order = order.append(node)
    mask := if node < tree.size then 2 ^ node else 0
    for child := tree.adjacent[node][]
        if child != parent
            children[node] = children[node].append(child)
            visit_nodes(tree, child, node, &parents, &children, &masks, &order)
            mask += masks[child]
    masks[node] = mask

Rooted root_tree(Tree tree, int outgroup)
    size := int(#tree.adjacent)
    root := tree.adjacent[outgroup][0]
    parents := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then -2]
    int[][] children := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then []]
    masks := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then 0]
    int[] order := []
    visit_nodes(tree, root, -1, &parents, &children, &masks, &order)
    return Rooted(root, parents, children, masks, order, masks[root] - 2 ^ outgroup)

int[] split_set(Tree tree, int outgroup)
    orientation := root_tree(tree, outgroup)
    return [for node := tree.internal_nodes()[] if node != orientation.root then orientation.masks[node]].sorted()

Tree neighbor_joining(real64[][] matrix, int[] taxa)
    size := int(#matrix)
    result := empty_tree(size)
    capacity := 2 * size
    pair_distances := [for i := (0:<int(capacity))[] then [for j := (0:<int(capacity))[] then (if i < size and j < size then matrix[i][j] else 0.0)]]
    active := taxa
    while #active >= 4
        count := int(#active)
        real64[] totals := [for i := (0:<int(capacity))[] then 0.0]
        for first := active[]
            for second := active[]
                if first != second
                    totals[first] += pair_distances[first][second]
        first := active[0]
        second := active[1]
        minimum := real64(count - 2) * pair_distances[first][second] - totals[first] - totals[second]
        for: i < count
            for: i + 1 <= j < count
                a := active[i]
                b := active[j]
                value := real64(count - 2) * pair_distances[a][b] - totals[a] - totals[b]
                if value < minimum
                    minimum = value
                    first = a
                    second = b
        node := .result.internal()
        distance := pair_distances[first][second]
        first_length := distance / 2.0 + (totals[first] - totals[second]) / real64(2 * (count - 2))
        .result.connect(first, node, first_length)
        .result.connect(second, node, distance - first_length)
        remaining := [for other := active[] if other != first and other != second then other]
        for other := remaining[]
            value := (pair_distances[first][other] + pair_distances[second][other] - distance) / 2.0
            pair_distances[node][other] = value
            pair_distances[other][node] = value
        active = remaining.append(node)
    first := active[0]
    second := active[1]
    third := active[2]
    node := .result.internal()
    a := pair_distances[first][second]
    b := pair_distances[first][third]
    c := pair_distances[second][third]
    .result.connect(first, node, (a + b - c) / 2.0)
    .result.connect(second, node, (a + c - b) / 2.0)
    .result.connect(third, node, (b + c - a) / 2.0)
    for edge := result.edges()[]
        if result.lengths[edge[0]][edge[1]] < 0.0
            .result.connect(edge[0], edge[1], 0.0)
            result.negative += 1
    return result

real64[] path_distances(Tree tree, int start)
    size := int(#tree.adjacent)
    real64[] result := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then 0.0]
    int[][] stack := [[start, -1]]
    while #stack != 0
        item := stack[-1]
        stack = stack[0:<int(#stack) - 1]
        for neighbour := tree.adjacent[item[0]][]
            if neighbour != item[1]
                result[neighbour] = result[item[0]] + tree.lengths[item[0]][neighbour]
                stack = stack.append([neighbour, item[0]])
    return result

int[] path_steps(Tree tree, int start)
    size := int(#tree.adjacent)
    result := [for i := (0:<int(size))[] then 0]
    int[][] stack := [[start, -1]]
    while #stack != 0
        item := stack[-1]
        stack = stack[0:<int(#stack) - 1]
        for neighbour := tree.adjacent[item[0]][]
            if neighbour != item[1]
                result[neighbour] = result[item[0]] + 1
                stack = stack.append([neighbour, item[0]])
    return result

real64[][] patristic_matrix(Tree tree)
    real64[][] result := [for i := (0:<int(tree.size))[] then [for j := (0:<int(tree.size))[] then 0.0]]
    taxa := tree.taxa()
    for first := taxa[]
        values := path_distances(tree, first)
        for second := taxa[]
            result[first][second] = values[second]
    return result

import math
import tree_building = "./tree_building.qui"

int rounded_units(real64 value, int places)
    magnitude := if value < 0.0 then -value else value
    units := math.floor(magnitude * real64(10 ^ places) + 0.5)
    return if value < 0.0 then -units else units

string format_real(real64 value, int places)
    factor := 10 ^ places
    units := rounded_units(value, places)
    sign := if units < 0 then "-" else ""
    if units < 0
        units = -units
    tail := string(units % factor)
    return sign + string(units / factor) + "." + "0" * nat(places - int(#tail)) + tail

bool contains_taxon(int mask, int taxon)
    return (mask / (2 ^ taxon)) % 2 == 1

string symbols(int mask, int size)
    return [for taxon := (0:<int(size))[] then (if contains_taxon(mask, taxon) then "*" else ".")].join("")

int symbol_key(int mask, int size)
    key := 0
    for: taxon < size
        key = 2 * key + (if contains_taxon(mask, taxon) then 0 else 1)
    return key

int[] ordered_masks(int[] masks, int size)
    base := 2 ^ size
    keys := [for mask := masks[] then symbol_key(mask, size) * base + mask]
    return [for key := keys.sorted()[] then key % base]

int[][] child_order(tree_building.Tree tree, tree_building.Rooted orientation, string[] names)
    size := int(#tree.adjacent)
    minimum := [for node := (0:<int(size))[] then ""]
    int[][] children := [for node := (0:<int(size))[] then []]
    for node := orientation.order[::-1][]
        if node < tree.size
            minimum[node] = names[node]
        else
            ordered := [for child := orientation.children[node][] then minimum[child]].sorted()
            for name := ordered[]
                for child := orientation.children[node][]
                    if minimum[child] == name
                        children[node] = children[node].append(child)
                        break
            minimum[node] = ordered[0]
    return children

string node_text(tree_building.Tree tree, tree_building.Rooted orientation, int[][] children, string[] names, int node, bool lengths, int[] support, bool with_support)
    text := ""
    if node < tree.size
        text = names[node]
    else
        text = "(" + [for child := children[node][] then node_text(tree, orientation, children, names, child, lengths, support, with_support)].join(",") + ")"
        if with_support and node != orientation.root
            text += string(support[orientation.masks[node]])
    if lengths and node != orientation.root
        text += ":" + format_real(tree.lengths[node][orientation.parents[node]], 5)
    return text

string newick(tree_building.Tree tree, string[] names, int outgroup, bool lengths, int[] support, bool with_support)
    orientation := tree_building.root_tree(tree, outgroup)
    children := child_order(tree, orientation, names)
    return node_text(tree, orientation, children, names, orientation.root, lengths, support, with_support) + ";"

void descend(tree_building.Tree tree, tree_building.Rooted orientation, int[][] children, string[] names, int[] support, int node, string prefix, string[] &lines)
    for: i < int(#children[node])
        child := children[node][i]
        last := i + 1 == int(#children[node])
        connector := if last then "`-- " else "|-- "
        label := if child < tree.size then names[child] else "[{support[orientation.masks[child]]}]"
        lines = lines.append(prefix + connector + label)
        descend(tree, orientation, children, names, support, child, prefix + (if last then "    " else "|   "), &lines)

string[] cladogram(tree_building.Tree tree, string[] names, int outgroup, int[] support)
    orientation := tree_building.root_tree(tree, outgroup)
    children := child_order(tree, orientation, names)
    lines := ["*"]
    descend(tree, orientation, children, names, support, orientation.root, "", &lines)
    return lines
